title: fun club funpack 1 ready to ship!
author: bpatrick
html: I’m a few days late but I’ve finally got the first funpack ready to ship out to the members of the fun club! If you want to get funpack 2 join the club!
postClass: post-785 post type-post status-publish format-standard hentry category-news uentry post-blog postonpage-1 odd post-author-bpatrick

comments.author: AJ
comments.html: i am very jealous, i literally have no money, but keep up the good work

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.html: did you actually ship? because I haven’t gotten anything yet . . . .

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.html: It was like 5 days after this post but they got in the mail. You should be getting it any day! Let me know if it’s lame. I want the fun club stuff to be cool.

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.html: LOL it was in the box when I got home! And it is super cool – ONAN!

comments.author: D
comments.html: Thank you so much for the fun pack, b.patrick! This is the primeval matter so to speak, and I’m holding it in my hands! I love it, thanks.

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.html: Thank you, D! Five more to come and they get better (I think/hope.)

comments.author: 84t9eghw08h2s7xw3
comments.html:
I hope you don’t mind me hanging my funpack above my wardrobe http://imgur.com/4GdbR

Thanks again

comments.author: kevin
comments.html: I made two payments over the course of about a year, adding up to $50. The last one was about a week ago. Still count ?

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.html: @kevin: Of course it counts! I’m working on fun pack #2 and I’ll get a fun pack 1 out to you soon. Thanks!

comments.author: kevin
comments.html: How’s med school going? You going to be keeping up with your comics when you’re a rich and successful doctor ?

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.html: @kevin: Med school’s crazy, thanks for asking. But my primary position is always that the worst day at med school is still better than the best day cutting meat. At least for me. I can never stop making comics. It’s a sickness.

comments.author: OblakavLese
comments.html: Question do you ship internationally because I’m from Czech Republic?

comments.author: kevin
comments.html:
@BPatrick.

My father has a good med school story. They were in a class that was dissecting (is that the right term?) a cadaver.

The Dr/Professor asked “Does anyone know why this man is in here?”.

To which he replied “because he’s dead?”.

The professor said “No! It’s because he didn’t listen to his doctor, if he had, he’d still be alive”.

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.html: @kevin: ha! That’s good. Non-compliance of patients seems to be a running theme.
